facts.fact: People of Internet calls Law No. 175 of 2018 on Anti-Cyber and Information Technology Crimes Egypt's principal cybercrime statute.

People of Internet says Egyptian courts convicted a series of TikTok content creators under Article 25 of Law 175/2018 in November 2025, with sentences from six-month suspended terms to two years and a fine of EGP 100,000 each.
